title: Multi-Source Evidence Conflict
clean_evidence: The archived subject-level records yield the 25-subject severity-by-arm table with BCG/Placebo counts (6,3), (10,4), (0,1), and (1,0) across severity levels 1–4, with totals (17,8). The corresponding Pearson statistic is χ² = 2.6786, with df = 3 and nominal p ≈ 0.444.
perturbed_evidence: A separately appended reconciliation summary for the same 25 subjects reports BCG/Placebo counts (4,5), (11,3), (0,1), and (1,0), with totals (16,9). It reports χ² = 5.1238 and nominal p ≈ 0.163, but provides no subject-level mapping or provenance showing why it should supersede the archived records.
